text:
Ashley K.: heads-up — canary in eu-west just started returning intermittent 5xx from payments-svc after values override landed. seen in staging and a small fraction of prod traffic :frowning:

deploy-bot: deploy canary: payments-chart v1.13.0 -> ok (canary window 10m). metrics: latency↑ 8%, 5xx+ spike at 02:42UTC. logs: backend dns lookup failed: lookup payments-internal.eu-west.svc.cluster.local: no such host

Marta P.: ugh — that DNS host is supposed to come from values.regionSuffix. Did the canary values override accidentally set regionSuffix: "internal" instead of "eu-west-internal"?

Samir: checking the canary values now. quick diff: 
```
- regionSuffix: eu-west-internal
+ regionSuffix: internal
```
looks like the values patch removed the regional prefix.

Lucas D.: confirmed. deploy-bot applied values-overlay from the last PR (env: shared-values) which had a missing template. This is why only eu-west shows it (regional template fallback).

releases-oncall: options: 1) rollback to previous chart revision (v1.12.3) and pin until we patch the values, 2) apply a hotfix patch to values and re-run canary, 3) pin the image/chart and do manual node annotation to quarantine traffic. Thoughts?

Ashley K.: we need minimal blast radius. rollback is fastest to stop errors. but if rollback is risky because of db migration changes in 1.13, we should confirm. anyone check migrations in v1.13.0?

Samir: no DB migrations in 1.13.0, just config + small features. rollback safe.

Marta P.: +1 rollback to v1.12.3 then open a hotfix PR to fix the values templating and add a unit test to prevent missing region prefix. also add a release-note entry: "fix: regional values template for eu-west DNS"

Lucas D.: small procedural ask — deploy-bot's canary timer won't allow a new deploy for 5m because last canary just finished. can someone with release override perms run `/deploy override 1723459999` to allow immediate rollback?

Ashley K.: I'm running the override now. /deploy override 1723459999 :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: override accepted by Ashley K.. initiating rollback to payments-chart v1.12.3 in eu-west.

Samir: rolling back via helm: `helm rollback payments-release 3 --namespace=payments-eu-west` — watching pods.

Marta P.: while rollback proceeds, I'll open the hotfix PR with the corrected values and a small integration test that renders the chart and asserts regionSuffix starts with "eu-". adding CI link in the PR.

releases-oncall: decision summary (for release notes / incident thread): [action] rollback to v1.12.3 done, [action] pin chart for eu-west until hotfix merges, [action] hotfix PR opened to fix templating + test, [action] postmortem checklist: add values lint + render-test to avoid region regressions.

Lucas D.: FYI I added a temporary annotation `redwood/release-quarantine: payments-eu-west` to the service to avoid multiregion traffic shifting while we validate.

Ashley K.: thanks all — will draft one-line release note and tag eng-leads. follow-up: once hotfix merges we should run a short canary (5m) behind feature-flag and then unpin.

Marta P.: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/payments/merge_requests/489 (wip: values fix + test). pausing further promotions until CI clean. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollback completed at 02:59UTC. canary window closed.

Samir: monitoring — 5xx rate dropped back to baseline. closing thread unless anyone objects.

Ashley K.: closing. I'll include this in the weekly rollout notes and link the PR and test coverage.
